parts.refutation: Check 'Rail's own latch' fails: V283 requires only that converter to switch off and stay off until the operator clear control (F11) clears it. The MCP9808 has no such latch: comparator mode releases when TA falls below the limit less THYST; TCRIT forces comparator mode; interrupt mode (TUPPER/TLOWER) releases only on an I2C write of Int. Clear, which is firmware, not the F11 control; all registers return to defaults at power-on reset (VPOR 2.2 V, falling VDD). No sensor can meet it alone: the latch is a separate part, a function round 2 does not list. The other 9 checks pass.
